decision.message: downloads a file over https and installs it on the node as root (or one member of it, a .tar.gz), only if its sha256 is the one of this plan, with the mode and owner of this plan, and restarts the services it names
decision.hint: check the URL and the sha256 against the publisher's release (its checksum file) before approving: what is installed runs, or is read, as this plan says
